text: Being here, surrounded by sleek glass walls and vivid displays of innovation, I feel a curious blend of anticipation and introspection. The emptiness of the meeting room contrasts with the vibrancy of the R+D exhibit, invoking thoughts on the boundary between creation and discussion. The environment feels both clinical and inspiring—a stage set for new possibilities to be conceived, questioned, and realized. I sense an undercurrent of restless energy, as if ideas themselves were waiting to take shape in this space.
